confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Nha Trang tourist pricing; no live listings or price pages were checked. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately reliable, while accommodation is least certain because July is peak season and rates vary widely by location and booking date. Cocktail and wine were set at roughly 4.4 to 4.8 times the draft beer anchor because direct local knowledge is weaker. The FX observation came from RBA exchange-rate excerpts returned by search, not a full table download, and some dates in those excerpts conflicted, so verify it against the RBA daily exchange-rate table before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against other Vietnamese coastal beach-resort cities with similar tourist pricing, such as Da Nang and Vung Tau, adjusted to Nha Trang's mid-range tourist level.
